description: How have Italian house prices moved? Paid ($0.03 USDC): ISTAT quarterly house price index (IPAB, base 2025=100) for Italy, macro-areas and Torino/Milano/Roma, all / new / existing dwellings, latest, 4-quarter and 12-quarter change (CC BY 4.0; no endorsement by ISTAT). Information, not financial advice. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/it-house-prices. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
